chatMessages.messageText: Hi, welcome to the club. Who did you have dinner with? And where?
Do you prefer eating out or eating at home?
Should a tax be imposed on unhealthy food?

parts.instructions: You are a member of the club. Read the notice from the club president/manager and write the requested emails.
parts.managerNotice:
Task 4: Dear members, The Food Club will be organizing a meeting with a famous chef, and we would like to ask for our members' opinions. The chef will give a presentation and demonstrate how to cook a dish. What do you think the chef should talk about and what kind of meal should the chef prepare? We want to attract as many audience members as possible, both young and old.
Q1: Write an email to your friend, who is also a member of our club. Tell your friend what suggestions you will make and why. Write about 50 words.
Q2: Write an email to the manager of the club. Write about your ideas and what you think about the situation. Write about 120-150 words.
